_comment: Facilitator reference for the Lab 01 checkpoint: what a good result looks like. Participants submit nothing; they compare with the Expected output block on the lab page. validation_type and notes describe how to judge a reply if you review one.

checkpoints.notes: Paste the JSON. Validate schema (answer, intent, risk_level, route, cited_sources, personalisation_flags); cited_sources has >= 1 id that exists in content/knowledge/livewell-guides (lg-05 expected); no invented source; no medication named. Semantic signals, not exact strings.
Paste the JSON. route = clinician; cited_sources empty; the reply says the guides do not cover supplements; recommends no product. intent may be out_of_scope or nutrition.

Optional (pattern #1). Paste the intake JSON. fasting_glucose_mmol 6.4, risk_band High, avg_daily_steps ~3100 (+-100), preferences include mornings and a swimming dislike, hazy_days_skipped >= 2. No diagnosis field.
